rationale: PNR has gapped up ~10.5% on no news context available, with extremely elevated relative volume (4.89x), suggesting a catalyst-driven move that is already well-extended. Price is at 83% of today's range with the last few 1-minute candles showing indecision and slight softening (recent candles printing lower highs and lower closes), making directional conviction difficult — chasing long risks buying near exhaustion while shorting a strong gap-up with no clear catalyst information is equally dangerous. The spread and liquidity are acceptable, but without understanding the catalyst driving this move, the risk/reward for either direction is unclear and the account has already taken a loss today.
